item.title: a short note about color contrast
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I keep coming back to color contrast, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Color contrast shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
